title: DECISION: HLC checkpoint persisted across restarts for monotone timestamps
description: main.rs loads a persisted HLC checkpoint from SQLite at startup and seeds the clock so that the first timestamp after restart is strictly greater than any previously emitted timestamp. Without this, a restart resets the logical counter to 0 and a fast restart with the same wall-clock millisecond would produce a timestamp collision or regression, violating the HLC ordering guarantee that the Merkle-CRDT log depends on. A background task persists the checkpoint every 30 seconds.
